blockingIssues.description: `rotate_log` archive cleanup stops at the first missing index, so sparse archive numbering can retain files beyond `max_files`, violating retention guarantees.
`restart_service` removes PID files before lock acquisition; on lock acquisition failure, crashed services can be reclassified as stopped and never auto-restarted.
`uninstall_agent` swallows launchctl unload failures and still removes the plist, which can report uninstall success while the agent remains loaded/running.
`install --status` bypasses non-macOS platform guarding and can return normal status output where a platform error is required.
Cross-ops tests for VAL-CROSS-OPS-003 do not validate launchctl bootstrap/bootout invocation, so launchd-started watchdog behavior is not fully covered at the launchctl boundary.
The full lifecycle test for VAL-CROSS-OPS-005 does not execute an actual `logs --follow` flow; it only reads/writes files directly, leaving the required follow-stream step unvalidated.

appliedUpdates.description: Added a log-follow caveat in `.factory/library/architecture.md` documenting the truncate+rewrite same-size edge case for `follow_log` truncation detection.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add watchdog restart-flow guidance that PID files must not be removed before lock acquisition succeeds, and failed restart attempts must preserve crashed-state observability for subsequent polls.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: watchdog-command review found a blocking bug from removing PID before lock acquisition; lock contention then makes crashed services appear stopped and non-restartable.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Fix skill availability mapping so features configured with `skillName: cli-feature` can actually invoke `cli-feature` at runtime.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Multiple ops reviews observed transcript errors `Skill "cli-feature" not found` despite `.factory/skills/cli-feature/SKILL.md` existing.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update `cli-feature` instructions to match repo reality (`src/mlx_stack/cli/main.py` is the command registry, not `cli/__init__.py`).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: watchdog-command review noted skill guidance references `cli/__init__.py`, but command registration in this repo is done in `cli/main.py`.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify `cli-feature` test-first requirements with explicit exceptions/alternative flow for lint-only/typecheck-only maintenance fixes.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fix-ops-lint-errors and related reviews highlighted procedural ambiguity where strict TDD steps do not fit pure static-cleanup tasks.
